mapper.update: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'ERRORS' and xtype = 'U') CREATE TABLE cts.dbo.ERRORS ( device_id int NOT NULL, intMode int NOT NULL, frequency int NOT NULL, enabled int NOT NULL, timeout int, garbageLength int, CONSTRAINT FK_ERRORS_DEVICES FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES cts.dbo.DEVICES (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE, );
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ERRORS (device_id, intMode, frequency, timeout, garbageLength, enabled) VALUES (#{device_id}, #{intMode}, #{frequency}, #{timeout}, #{garbageLength}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE ERRORS SET intMode = #{intMode}, frequency = #{frequency}, enabled = #{enabled}, timeout = #{timeout}, garbageLength = #{garbageLength} WHERE device_id = #{device_id}
